compute_mae: compute the mean absolute error between predicted and target tensor values using the mae metric function
compute_mse: compute the mean squared error between predicted and target tensor values using the mse metric function
compute_cosine_similarity: compute cosine similarity between predicted and target tensor embeddings using the cosine_similarity metric function
compute_per_atom_mae: compute the per-atom mean absolute error normalized by atom count using the per_atom_mae metric function
get_metrics_fn: retrieve a callable metric function by name using the get_metrics_fn factory function
